newsitem.title: USA: FTC rejects Staples/Office Depot merge in 4-1 vote.
newsitem.headline: FTC rejects Staples/Office Depot merge in 4-1 vote.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission said Friday it voted 4 to 1 to reject the revised merger of Staples and Office Depot, with Commissioner Roscoe Starek dissenting.
Commissioner Mary Azcuenaga voted yes on the motion to reject the settlement on the grounds there was no reason to believe that the proposed merger ever was a violation of law.
In a news release, FTC Bureau of Competition Director William Baer said the FTC had found prices cheaper in cities where there were three office superstores instead of two.
"If the merger is allowed to proceed, consumers will pay millions of dollars more for their copy paper, envelopes, pens and file folders," Baer said.
